expiry: Satellite target expires horizon sessions after its signal; renewal requires current entry threshold, without forcing an unnecessary sale and repurchase

transfer_teacher: The fixed 9-theme older pool for the 13-theme pool only
blend: Equal-weight teacher/local forecasts when both have matured-history models; otherwise the one available model

unbounded satellite retention versus signal expiry
limitations: This protocol follows prior historical experiments; no untouched holdout claimed
